request: Rewrite this error message. An agent parses it and decides what to do next.
input: Oops! It looks like something went wrong while we were trying to upload your file — the upload may have been rejected because the file is larger than the 25 MB limit or the storage quota has been exceeded (error UPL-413). Please don't worry, you can try compressing the file and uploading again, but do not retry more than 3 times as the account could potentially be temporarily locked.
